record.name: Otter AI
record.one_liner: AI-powered meeting transcription, recording, and notetaking assistant with Model Context Protocol (MCP) support and API integration.
record.access_note: Users can sign up for a free Otter Basic account or subscribe to paid plans, with API and enterprise features available on higher tiers.
record.api_note: Covers webhooks, transcripts, and integrations with third-party tools via API.

evidence.quote: Otter's MCP implementation uses OAuth-based authentication.
